settings.html:
<!-- ProVision Infra: Karriereseite (Elementor-HTML-Widget) -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/elementor/google-fonts/css/poppins.css">
<link rel="preload" as="image" href="https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-ellipse-5-1.png">
<style>





:root{
  --c-primary:#000000;
  --c-secondary:#54595F;
  --c-text:#7A7A7A;
  --c-white:#FFFFFF;
  --c-dark:#2B2B2B;
  --c-blue:#263E96;
  --c-yellow:#FBC91B;
  --c-navy:#000D30;
  --c-navy-hero:#000b2c;
  --c-navy-2:#010A2C;
  --c-navy-3:#0E1E51;
  --c-navy-4:#2B3966;
  --c-arrow:#2B3C77;
  --c-glass:#FFFFFF0A;
  --c-glass-2:#FFFFFF14;
  --c-glass-3:#FFFFFF1F;
  --c-glass-4:#FFFFFF29;
  --c-border:#FFFFFF52;
  --c-border-2:#FFFFFF7A;
  --c-border-3:#FFFFFF66;
  --c-border-4:#FFFFFF38;
  --c-mint:#8CE8CC;
  --font:"Poppins",sans-serif;
  --container:1400px;
  --header-h:112px;
  --anim-duration:1.25s;
}


*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;}
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family:var(--font);
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.64em;
  font-weight:400;
  color:var(--c-white);
  background:var(--c-navy);
  overflow-x:hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
#pk-karriere img{max-width:100%;height:auto;border:0;display:block;}
#pk-karriere a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
#pk-karriere h1,#pk-karriere h2,#pk-karriere h3,#pk-karriere h4,#pk-karriere p,#pk-karriere ul{margin:0;padding:0;}
#pk-karriere ul{list-style:none;}
#pk-karriere button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:0;color:inherit;}

#pk-karriere :where(.pk-header,.pk-main,.pk-footer) :is(button,[type="button"],[type="submit"]){
  background:none;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;color:inherit;font:inherit;line-height:inherit;
  letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;min-height:0;min-width:0;width:auto;text-decoration:none;
  white-space:normal;text-align:inherit;
}

#pk-karriere :where(.pk-header,.pk-main,.pk-footer) :is(button,[type="button"],[type="submit"]):is(:hover,:focus,:focus-visible,:active){
  background:none;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;border-color:transparent;
}

#pk-karriere .pk-main,#pk-karriere .pk-footer,#pk-karriere .section{overflow-x:clip;}
#pk-karriere #arbeiten{overflow-x:visible;} 
#pk-karriere .skip-link{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;background:var(--c-yellow);color:var(--c-dark);padding:8px 16px;z-index:100000;}
#pk-karriere .skip-link:focus{left:10px;top:10px;}


#pk-karriere .h-lg{font-size:42px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.24em;}
#pk-karriere .h-md{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.24em;}
#pk-karriere .h-sm{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.24em;}
#pk-karriere .h-xs{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.24em;}
#pk-karriere .center{text-align:center;}
#pk-karriere strong,#pk-karriere b{font-weight:700;}
#pk-karriere .yellow{color:var(--c-yellow);}


#pk-karriere .svg-sprite{display:none;}
#pk-karriere .u-mb-20{margin-bottom:20px}#pk-karriere .u-mb-24{margin-bottom:24px}#pk-karriere .u-mb-30{margin-bottom:30px}#pk-karriere .u-mb-40{margin-bottom:40px}
#pk-karriere .u-mt-16{margin-top:16px}#pk-karriere .u-mt-30{margin-top:30px}#pk-karriere .u-mt-40{margin-top:40px}#pk-karriere .u-mt-50{margin-top:50px}#pk-karriere .u-pt-50{padding-top:50px}
#pk-karriere .intro{max-width:860px;margin:24px auto 0;line-height:1.7em;}
#pk-karriere .intro--gap{margin-bottom:40px;}
#pk-karriere .note{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);}
#pk-karriere .bg--soft{opacity:.6;}


#pk-karriere .section{position:relative;padding:50px 20px;}
#pk-karriere .container{position:relative;max-width:var(--container);margin:0 auto;width:100%;}
#pk-karriere .container--narrow{max-width:1100px;}
#pk-karriere .divider{display:block;width:100%;max-width:1400px;height:1px;margin:0 auto;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.45),transparent);}


#pk-karriere .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background-repeat:no-repeat;z-index:0;
  
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0,#000 16%,#000 84%,transparent 100%);
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0,#000 16%,#000 84%,transparent 100%);
}
#pk-karriere .bg--blue-center{background-image:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-ellipse-3-1.png");background-position:center center;background-size:contain;}
#pk-karriere .bg--blue-right{background-image:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-ellipse-3-1.png");background-position:center right;background-size:45% auto;}
#pk-karriere .bg--blue-topright{background-image:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-ellipse-3-1.png");background-position:top right;background-size:55% auto;}
#pk-karriere .bg--blue-left{background-image:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-ellipse-4-1.png");background-position:0 -25px;background-size:40% auto;opacity:.6;}
#pk-karriere .bg--blue-rightside{background-image:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-ellipse-5-1.png");background-position:center right;background-size:40% auto;}
#pk-karriere .bg--yellow-left{background-image:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-left-1.png");background-position:center left;background-size:contain;opacity:.5;}
#pk-karriere .bg--yellow-left.bg--o80{opacity:.8;}
#pk-karriere .bg--yellow-right{background-image:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-right-1.png");background-position:center right;background-size:contain;mix-blend-mode:screen;}
#pk-karriere .bg--v{background-image:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/glow-frame.png");background-position:left top;background-size:50% auto;opacity:.5;}
#pk-karriere .section > .container{z-index:1;}


#pk-karriere .shadeup::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:100px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,#030F29,transparent);pointer-events:none;z-index:1;}


#pk-karriere .pk-header{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;
  padding:20px;z-index:9999;
  display:flex;justify-content:center;
}
#pk-karriere .pk-header__inner{
  width:100%;max-width:var(--container);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:16px 80px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  border-radius:55px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(1px);backdrop-filter:blur(1px);
}
#pk-karriere .pk-header__logo{width:20%;display:flex;justify-content:flex-start;}
#pk-karriere .pk-header__logo a{display:block;width:100%;transition:transform .4s;}
#pk-karriere .pk-header__logo a:hover{transform:scale(1.04);}
#pk-karriere .pk-header__logo img{width:100%;max-width:244px;}
#pk-karriere .pk-header__nav{width:80%;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;}
#pk-karriere .nav-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;}
#pk-karriere .nav-menu li{margin:0 15px;}
#pk-karriere .nav-menu li:last-child{margin-right:0;}
#pk-karriere .nav-menu a{font-size:18px;font-weight:400;line-height:20px;color:var(--c-white);padding:13px 0;display:block;transition:color .4s;white-space:nowrap;}
#pk-karriere .nav-menu a:hover,#pk-karriere .nav-menu a:focus,#pk-karriere .nav-menu a.is-active{color:var(--c-yellow);}
#pk-karriere button.menu-toggle{display:none;width:33px;height:33px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--c-white);background:rgba(0,0,0,.05);border-radius:3px;}
#pk-karriere button.menu-toggle:hover,#pk-karriere button.menu-toggle:focus{color:var(--c-yellow);background:rgba(0,0,0,.05);}
#pk-karriere .menu-toggle svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:currentColor;}
#pk-karriere .menu-toggle .icon-close{display:none;}
#pk-karriere .menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .icon-open{display:none;}
#pk-karriere .menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .icon-close{display:block;}
#pk-karriere .nav-dropdown{
  display:none;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:none;
  z-index:9999;
  grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .25s ease;
}
#pk-karriere .nav-dropdown__inner{overflow:hidden;}
#pk-karriere .nav-dropdown.is-open{grid-template-rows:1fr;}
#pk-karriere .nav-dropdown a{display:block;padding:10px 20px;font-size:12px;line-height:20px;color:var(--c-dark);transition:background .3s,color .3s;}
#pk-karriere .nav-dropdown a:hover,#pk-karriere .nav-dropdown a.is-active{background:var(--c-yellow);color:var(--c-dark);}


#pk-karriere .btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  flex-direction:row-reverse;gap:16px;
  background:var(--c-yellow);color:var(--c-dark);
  font-family:var(--font);font-size:18px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.64em;
  padding:16px 16px 16px 32px;border-radius:100px;
  box-shadow:-4px 2px 8.8px 0 rgba(38,62,150,.15) inset;
  transition:all .3s;
  position:relative;z-index:2;
}
#pk-karriere .btn:hover,#pk-karriere .btn:focus,#pk-karriere .btn:active{transform:scale(1.1);box-shadow:0 -5px 10px 5px rgba(251,201,27,.57);color:var(--c-dark);}
#pk-karriere .btn__icon{position:relative;width:40px;height:40px;flex:0 0 40px;}
#pk-karriere .btn__icon svg{width:40px;height:40px;transition:opacity .3s ease;}
#pk-karriere .btn__icon::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s ease;pointer-events:none;
}
#pk-karriere .btn:hover .btn__icon svg{opacity:0;}
#pk-karriere .btn:hover .btn__icon::after{opacity:1;}
#pk-karriere .btn--sm{font-size:16px;padding:12px 12px 12px 24px;}
#pk-karriere .btn--sm .btn__icon,#pk-karriere .btn--sm .btn__icon svg{width:34px;height:34px;flex-basis:34px;}


#pk-karriere .textlink{color:var(--c-yellow);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}
#pk-karriere .textlink:hover{color:#fff;}
#pk-karriere .hero{
  position:relative;
  background:var(--c-navy-hero);
  padding:200px 20px 100px;
  min-height:900px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;
  overflow:hidden;
}
#pk-karriere .hero .bg--blue-rightside{opacity:.9;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 70%,transparent 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 70%,transparent 100%);}
#pk-karriere .hero__inner{width:75%;max-width:var(--container);margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
#pk-karriere .hero__title{width:78%;max-width:78%;padding:0 0 40px;font-size:52px;font-weight:400;line-height:124%;color:var(--c-white);}
#pk-karriere .hero__title b{font-weight:700;}
#pk-karriere .hero__sub{width:70%;max-width:70%;padding:0 0 40px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.7em;}
#pk-karriere .hero__sub p + p{margin-top:1.4em;}
#pk-karriere .hero__cta{display:flex;align-items:center;}
#pk-karriere .hero__stats{display:flex;align-items:center;margin-top:80px;gap:0;}
#pk-karriere .stat-google{display:flex;align-items:center;width:300px;gap:14px;}
#pk-karriere .stat-google__logo{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 52px;}
#pk-karriere .stat-google__logo img{width:30px;height:auto;}
#pk-karriere .stat-google__rating{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;}
#pk-karriere .stat-google__rating svg{width:25px;height:25px;fill:var(--c-yellow);}
#pk-karriere .stat-google__num{font-size:35px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;line-height:1;}
#pk-karriere .stat-google__suffix{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;margin-left:6px;white-space:nowrap;}
#pk-karriere .stat-google__label{font-size:18px;line-height:1.64em;}
#pk-karriere .counter{display:flex;flex-direction:row-reverse;align-items:center;gap:20px;max-width:300px;margin-right:35px;transition:transform .3s ease;}
#pk-karriere .counter:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}
#pk-karriere .counter__number{font-size:52px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.24em;white-space:nowrap;}
#pk-karriere .counter__prefix{color:var(--c-yellow);}
#pk-karriere .counter__title{font-size:16px;line-height:1.64em;}
#pk-karriere .stat-badge img{width:162px;height:auto;aspect-ratio:300/250;}


#pk-karriere .card-row{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:stretch;z-index:1;position:relative;}
#pk-karriere .glass-card{
  flex:1 1 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  padding:24px;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06),0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  transition:transform .4s;
  animation:floating 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
#pk-karriere .glass-card:hover{transform:scale(1.05);}
#pk-karriere .glass-card__icon{flex:0 0 50px;width:50px;height:50px;}
#pk-karriere .glass-card__icon svg{width:50px;height:50px;}
#pk-karriere .glass-card p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.64em;}
@keyframes floating{0%{translate:0 0}50%{translate:0 -10px}100%{translate:0 0}}



#pk-karriere .ico{display:inline-block;border-radius:14px;background:var(--c-yellow);color:var(--c-navy);}
#pk-karriere .ico svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;padding:22%;fill:none;stroke:var(--c-navy);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
#pk-karriere .ico--check{background:var(--c-yellow);border-radius:50%;}


#pk-karriere .feature-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:30px;}
#pk-karriere .feature-card{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--c-glass);
  border:2px solid var(--c-border-3);border-radius:24px;
  padding:32px;
  transition:transform .4s,background-color .4s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s;
}
#pk-karriere .feature-card:hover{
  background:var(--c-navy);border-color:var(--c-yellow);
  box-shadow:0 0 24.2px 0 rgba(250,211,126,.48);
  transform:scale(1.05);
}
#pk-karriere .feature-card__head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:32px;}
#pk-karriere .feature-card__icon{flex:0 0 60px;width:60px;height:60px;padding:0;border-radius:16px;margin-top:4px;}
#pk-karriere .feature-card__icon .ico{width:60px;height:60px;}
#pk-karriere .feature-card__body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;flex:1;}
#pk-karriere .feature-card__title{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.24em;}
#pk-karriere .feature-card p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.64em;}
#pk-karriere .feature-card__note{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  background:var(--c-glass);border-radius:16px;padding:16px 24px;
  font-weight:600;font-size:16px;line-height:1.64em;
}
#pk-karriere .feature-card__note .ico{flex:0 0 34px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;}


#pk-karriere .split{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:60px;margin-bottom:50px;}
#pk-karriere .split__left{width:40%;position:sticky;top:0;align-self:flex-start;}
@media (min-width:2400px){#pk-karriere .split__left{top:30px;}}
#pk-karriere .split__right{width:60%;}
#pk-karriere .split__left .h-lg{font-size:40px;margin-bottom:28px;}
#pk-karriere .split__left .h-sm{margin-bottom:24px;}
#pk-karriere .split__left p{font-size:16px;}


#pk-karriere .story{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;position:relative;}
#pk-karriere .story__col{width:36%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
#pk-karriere .story__col--center{width:28%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;position:relative;}
#pk-karriere .story__col--center img{width:100%;max-width:420px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
#pk-karriere .story-card{
  background:var(--c-glass);border:1px solid var(--c-border-2);border-radius:24px;
  padding:28px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75em;
  transition:transform .4s;
}
#pk-karriere .story-card:hover{transform:scale(1.04);}
#pk-karriere .story-card p + p{margin-top:1.5em;}
#pk-karriere .story-card--right{margin-left:-25px;}
#pk-karriere .story-card--left{margin-right:-25px;align-self:flex-start;}
#pk-karriere .story__col--right{justify-content:flex-end;}


#pk-karriere .highlight-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:20px 0 80px;}
#pk-karriere .highlight-card{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:32px;overflow:hidden;
  background:#C9C9C929;border:2px solid var(--c-yellow);border-radius:24px;
  box-shadow:0 -5px 25px 5px rgba(251,201,27,.57);
  padding:32px;text-align:center;
}
#pk-karriere .highlight-card p{font-size:24px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.24em;}


#pk-karriere .bento{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;}
#pk-karriere .bento__item{
  background:var(--c-glass);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:24px;
  padding:28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .4s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s;
}
#pk-karriere .bento__item:hover{transform:scale(1.04);border-color:rgba(251,201,27,.6);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(250,211,126,.25);}
#pk-karriere .bento__item--wide{grid-column:span 2;}
#pk-karriere .bento__item .ico{width:56px;height:56px;}
#pk-karriere .bento__item h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.24em;}
#pk-karriere .bento__item p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.64em;}
#pk-karriere .bento__num{position:absolute;right:22px;top:16px;font-size:48px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.07);line-height:1;}


#pk-karriere .benefits{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;}
#pk-karriere .benefit{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  background:var(--c-glass);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:16px;
  padding:18px 22px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5em;
  transition:transform .4s,background-color .3s;
}
#pk-karriere .benefit:hover{transform:scale(1.04);background:var(--c-glass-2);}
#pk-karriere .benefit .ico{flex:0 0 44px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;}



#pk-karriere .section.is-draft{display:none;}
#pk-karriere .testi-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:40px;}
#pk-karriere .testi-head .h-lg b{font-weight:700;}
#pk-karriere .carousel{position:relative;max-width:1700px;margin:0 auto;padding:50px 0 84px;}
#pk-karriere .carousel__viewport{overflow:hidden;padding:12px 0 20px;}
#pk-karriere .carousel__track{display:flex;transition:transform .5s ease;will-change:transform;}
#pk-karriere .carousel__slide{flex:0 0 33.3333%;padding:12px;display:flex;}
#pk-karriere .testi-card{
  width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px;
  padding:25px;border-radius:25px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#000D3000 0%,#000D307D 100%);
  border:1px solid transparent;
  transform:scale(.9);opacity:.6;
  transition:transform .4s ease-in-out,opacity .4s ease,border-color .4s,box-shadow .4s;
}
#pk-karriere .carousel__slide.is-active .testi-card{transform:scale(1);opacity:1;border-color:var(--c-yellow);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--c-yellow);min-height:324px;}
#pk-karriere .testi-card__stars{width:116px;height:20px;}
#pk-karriere .testi-card__stars svg{width:116px;height:20px;}
#pk-karriere .testi-card__text{font-size:16px;line-height:1.64em;color:#fff;}
#pk-karriere .testi-card__person{position:relative;padding-right:80px;}
#pk-karriere .testi-card__name{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin-bottom:0;}
#pk-karriere .testi-card__role{font-size:14px;color:#fff;}
#pk-karriere .testi-card__person::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;right:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:70px;height:70px;background:url("https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/quote.svg") center/contain no-repeat;
}
#pk-karriere button.carousel__arrow{

            <p>ProVision Infra hat als Schlüsselnotdienst in Bad Bevensen angefangen. Jannes, unser Gründer & Geschäftsführer, kommt aus dem Elektrohandwerk, hat später IT gelernt und war Berufsfeuerwehrmann in Hamburg. Türen öffnen und unter Druck entscheiden war lange sein Alltag.</p>

Bei Google stehen wir bei 5,0 Sternen, bei ProvenExpert bei 100 Prozent Empfehlung.</p>
            <p>Die Anfragen kommen schneller, als unser heutiges Team sie umsetzen kann. Deshalb gibt es diese Seite.</p>

  <!-- ================= FAQ ================= -->
  <section class="section" id="faq">
    <div class="bg bg--blue-topright"></div>
    <div class="bg bg--yellow-left bg--o80"></div>
    <div class="container">
      <h2 class="h-lg center anim u-mb-30" data-anim="fadeInUp">Fragen zur <b>Bewerbung</b></h2>
      <div class="faq anim" data-anim="fadeInUp">
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wann bekomme ich eine Rückmeldung?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Meist innerhalb von drei Werktagen. Hörst du nichts, ruf an unter <a href="tel:+4958214049040">05821 4049040</a> oder schreib an <a href="mailto:bewerbung@provision-infra.de">bewerbung@provision-infra.de</a>.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Brauche ich ein Anschreiben?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Nein. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Alles Weitere besprechen wir persönlich.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Ab wann sind die Stellen zu besetzen?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Ab sofort. Hast du eine Kündigungsfrist, bewirb dich trotzdem jetzt. Den Start stimmen wir gemeinsam ab.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Ich bin Quereinsteiger. Habe ich eine Chance?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Ja. Jannes, unser Gründer & Geschäftsführer, ist selbst über Umwege zur Zutrittstechnik gekommen. Technisches Grundverständnis und Lust auf Kunden zählen mehr als der Lebenslauf. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wie sehen die Arbeitszeiten aus?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Montag bis Donnerstag 9 bis 18 Uhr, Freitag 9 bis 14 Uhr. Im Technik-Team richten sich die Einsätze nach den Projekten. Das Wochenende gehört dir.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wo bin ich im Einsatz?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Unser Standort ist Bad Bevensen im Landkreis Uelzen. Die Kunden sitzen zwischen Hamburg und Hannover, viele davon in Lüneburg und im Landkreis Uelzen. Die meisten Einsätze sind Tagestouren.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wie steht ihr zum Thema Homeoffice?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Montage und Service finden beim Kunden statt. In IT und Projektierung ist Homeoffice anteilig möglich. Details klären wir im Gespräch.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wie lange dauert der Bewerbungsprozess?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Vom ersten Telefonat bis zur Zusage vergehen meist zwei bis drei Wochen. Rückmeldung bekommst du in jeder Phase schnell.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>

            b.bar.style.setProperty('--tl-progress', Math.round((last.top - first.top) * done / (n - 1)) + 'px');
          }
        }
      });
    }
    var ticking = false;
    function onScroll() { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(render); } }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
    window.addEventListener('load', render);
    render();

    // Original-Animation der Hauptseite (Lottie, scrollgebunden wie Elementors "bind to scroll").
    // Player kommt aus der Elementor-Pro-Bibliothek der eigenen Website; ohne Player bleibt die CSS-Rückfallebene.
    function startLottie() {
      var holder = desk.querySelector('.timeline__lottie');
      if (!holder || !window.lottie) return;
      anim = window.lottie.loadAnimation({
        container: holder, renderer: 'svg', loop: false, autoplay: false,
        path: desk.getAttribute('data-lottie'),
        rendererSettings: { preserveAspectRatio: 'xMidYMid meet', progressiveLoad: true }
      });
      anim.addEventListener('DOMLoaded', function () {
        totalFrames = anim.totalFrames;
        desk.classList.add('has-lottie');
        render();
      });
      anim.addEventListener('data_failed', function () { anim = null; });
    }
    if (desk && desk.getAttribute('data-lottie') && !prefersReduced) {
      if (window.lottie) { startLottie(); }
      else {
        var s = document.createElement('script');
        s.src = 'https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/plugins/elementor-pro/assets/lib/lottie/lottie.min.js?ver=5.6.6';
        s.async = true;
        s.onload = startLottie;
        document.head.appendChild(s);
      }
    }
  }

  /* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
  function initFaq() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq__item').forEach(function (item) {
      var btn = item.querySelector('.faq__header');
      if (!btn) return;
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var open = item.classList.contains('is-open');
        // Nur ein Element gleichzeitig offen (wie EAEL Accordion)
        item.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.faq__item.is-open').forEach(function (o) {
          o.classList.remove('is-open');
          o.querySelector('.faq__header').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
        if (!open) { item.classList.add('is-open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); }
      });
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Stellen: Filter + Akkordeon ---------- */
  function initJobs() {
    var jobs = document.querySelectorAll('.job');
    function setJob(job, open) {
      job.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
      var btn = job.querySelector('.job__btn');
      if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    jobs.forEach(function (job) {
      var head = job.querySelector('.job__head');
      if (!head) return;
      head.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('a')) return;
        setJob(job, !job.classList.contains('is-open'));
      });
    });
    var filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter [data-filter]');
    filterBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        filterBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle('is-active', b === btn); });
        var f = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
        jobs.forEach(function (job) {
          var show = f === 'all' || job.getAttribute('data-category') === f;
          job.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !show);
          if (show && !job.classList.contains('animated')) job.classList.add('animated', 'fadeInUp');
        });
      });
    });
    // Deep-Link: /karriere/#job-… öffnet die Stelle direkt (auch bei Hash-Wechsel)
    function openFromHash() {
      if (!location.hash || location.hash.indexOf('#job-') !== 0) return;
      var target = document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));
      if (target && target.classList.contains('job')) {
        target.classList.add('animated', 'fadeInUp');
        setJob(target, true);
      }
    }
    openFromHash();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', openFromHash);
  }

  /* ---------- Init ---------- */
  function init() {
    var y = document.getElementById('year');
    if (y) y.textContent = String(new Date().getFullYear());
    initMenu();
    initSmoothScroll();
    initActiveNav();
    initAnimations();
    initCounters();
    document.querySelectorAll('.carousel').forEach(initCarousel);
    initTimeline();
    initFaq();
    initJobs();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); else init();
})();

</script>

            <p>ProVision Infra hat als Schlüsselnotdienst in Bad Bevensen angefangen. Jannes, unser Gründer & Geschäftsführer, kommt aus dem Elektrohandwerk, hat später IT gelernt und war Berufsfeuerwehrmann in Hamburg. Türen öffnen und unter Druck entscheiden war lange sein Alltag.</p>

Bei Google stehen wir bei 5,0 Sternen, bei ProvenExpert bei 100 Prozent Empfehlung.</p>
            <p>Die Anfragen kommen schneller, als unser heutiges Team sie umsetzen kann. Deshalb gibt es diese Seite.</p>

      <h2 class="h-lg center anim u-mb-30" data-anim="fadeInUp">Fragen zur <b>Bewerbung</b></h2>
      <div class="faq anim" data-anim="fadeInUp">
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wann bekomme ich eine Rückmeldung?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Meist innerhalb von drei Werktagen. Hörst du nichts, ruf an unter <a href="tel:+4958214049040">05821 4049040</a> oder schreib an <a href="mailto:bewerbung@provision-infra.de">bewerbung@provision-infra.de</a>.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Brauche ich ein Anschreiben?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Nein. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Alles Weitere besprechen wir persönlich.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Ab wann sind die Stellen zu besetzen?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Ab sofort. Hast du eine Kündigungsfrist, bewirb dich trotzdem jetzt. Den Start stimmen wir gemeinsam ab.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Ich bin Quereinsteiger. Habe ich eine Chance?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Ja. Jannes, unser Gründer & Geschäftsführer, ist selbst über Umwege zur Zutrittstechnik gekommen. Technisches Grundverständnis und Lust auf Kunden zählen mehr als der Lebenslauf. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wie sehen die Arbeitszeiten aus?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Montag bis Donnerstag 9 bis 18 Uhr, Freitag 9 bis 14 Uhr. Im Technik-Team richten sich die Einsätze nach den Projekten. Das Wochenende gehört dir.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wo bin ich im Einsatz?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Unser Standort ist Bad Bevensen im Landkreis Uelzen. Die Kunden sitzen zwischen Hamburg und Hannover, viele davon in Lüneburg und im Landkreis Uelzen. Die meisten Einsätze sind Tagestouren.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wie steht ihr zum Thema Homeoffice?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Montage und Service finden beim Kunden statt. In IT und Projektierung ist Homeoffice anteilig möglich. Details klären wir im Gespräch.</p>
          </div></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="faq__item">
          <button class="faq__header" type="button" aria-expanded="false">
            <span class="faq__title">Wie lange dauert der Bewerbungsprozess?</span>
            <span class="faq__toggle" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 448 512"><path d="M256 80c0-17.7-14.3-32-32-32s-32 14.3-32 32V224H48c-17.7 0-32 14.3-32 32s14.3 32 32 32H192V432c0 17.7 14.3 32 32 32s32-14.3 32-32V288H400c17.7 0 32-14.3 32-32s-14.3-32-32-32H256V80z"/></svg></span>
          </button>
          <div class="faq__body"><div class="faq__body-inner"><div class="faq__content">
            <p>Vom ersten Telefonat bis zur Zusage vergehen meist zwei bis drei Wochen. Rückmeldung bekommst du in jeder Phase schnell.</p>

    function go(i) {
      var n = slides.length;
      index = ((i % n) + n) % n;
      update();
    }
    function restart() {
      if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
      if (prefersReduced || interacted) return;   // pause_on_interaction
      timer = setInterval(function () { go(index + 1); }, autoplay);
    }
    function userAction(fn) { return function () { interacted = true; if (timer) clearInterval(timer); fn(); }; }

    /* Für den "mittig aktiv"-Look mit 3 Slides pro Ansicht klonen wir die Slides vorne/hinten */
    if (slides.length >= 3) {
      var firstClone = slides[slides.length - 1].cloneNode(true);
      var lastClone = slides[0].cloneNode(true);
      firstClone.classList.add('is-clone'); lastClone.classList.add('is-clone');
      firstClone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); lastClone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      track.insertBefore(firstClone, slides[0]);
      track.appendChild(lastClone);
      var all = Array.prototype.slice.call(track.children);
      // Index-Mapping: echter Slide i befindet sich an Position i+1
      update = function () {
        perView = getPerView();
        var slideW = 100 / perView;
        var pos = index + 1; // Position im Track
        var offsetSlides = perView === 3 ? 1 : 0;
        var shift = (pos - offsetSlides) * slideW;
        track.style.transition = 'transform .5s ease';
        track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-shift) + '%)';
        all.forEach(function (s, p) { s.classList.toggle('is-active', p === pos); });
        if (dots) Array.prototype.forEach.call(dots.children, function (d, i) { d.classList.toggle('is-active', i === index); });
      };
      go = function (i) {
        var n = slides.length;
        var target = i;
        // Nahtloser Übergang über die Klone
        if (target < 0 || target >= n) {
          var pos = target + 1;
          perView = getPerView();
          var slideW = 100 / perView;
          var offsetSlides = perView === 3 ? 1 : 0;
          track.style.transition = 'transform .5s ease';
          track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-(pos - offsetSlides) * slideW) + '%)';
          all.forEach(function (s, p) { s.classList.toggle('is-active', p === pos); });
          index = ((target % n) + n) % n;
          if (dots) Array.prototype.forEach.call(dots.children, function (d, k) { d.classList.toggle('is-active', k === index); });
          setTimeout(function () {
            track.style.transition = 'none';
            update();
            // Reflow erzwingen, damit der Sprung ohne Animation passiert
            void track.offsetWidth;
            track.style.transition = 'transform .5s ease';
          }, 520);
          return;
        }
        index = target;
        update();
      };
    }

    if (prev) prev.addEventListener('click', userAction(function () { go(index - 1); }));
    if (next) next.addEventListener('click', userAction(function () { go(index + 1); }));

    // Swipe
    var startX = null;
    root.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { startX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
    root.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
      if (startX === null) return;
      var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - startX;
      if (Math.abs(dx) > 40) { interacted = true; if (timer) clearInterval(timer); go(dx < 0 ? index + 1 : index - 1); }
      startX = null;
    });
    root.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { if (timer) clearInterval(timer); });
    root.addEventListener('mouseleave', restart);
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { track.style.transition = 'none'; update(); void track.offsetWidth; track.style.transition = 'transform .5s ease'; });

    buildDots();
    update();
    restart();
  }

  /* ---------- Ablauf: scrollgebundene Sequenz (wie Lottie "bind to scroll" im Original) ----------
     Fortschritt 0..1 = Position des Blocks im Viewport (Eintritt unten -> Austritt oben).
     Reihenfolge je Schritt wie im Original: Punkt entriegelt (gelb + Glow), dann zeichnet sich die Linie zum nächsten Punkt. */
  function initTimeline() {
    var blocks = [];
    var desk = document.querySelector('.timeline');
    var mob = document.querySelector('.timeline-mobile');
    var anim = null, totalFrames = 0;
    if (desk) blocks.push({ el: desk, stage: desk.querySelector('.timeline__stage') || desk, dots: desk.querySelectorAll('.timeline__dot'), bar: desk.querySelector('.timeline__progress'), axis: 'x' });
    if (mob) blocks.push({ el: mob, stage: mob, dots: mob.querySelectorAll('li'), bar: mob, axis: 'y' });
    if (!blocks.length) return;
    var STEP = 54 / 327, DOT0 = 10 / 327, LINE0 = 44 / 327, LINE_LEN = 20 / 327; // Frames des Originals (327 Frames gesamt)
    function clamp(v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)); }
    function progressOf(el) {
      var vh = window.innerHeight, r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return prefersReduced ? 1 : clamp((vh - r.top) / (vh + r.height));
    }
    function render() {
      ticking = false;
      blocks.forEach(function (b) {
        if (!b.el.offsetParent) return;
        var p = progressOf(b.stage);
        if (b.axis === 'x' && anim && totalFrames) {
          anim.goToAndStop(Math.round(p * (totalFrames - 1)), true);
        }
        var n = b.dots.length, done = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          var active = p >= DOT0 + STEP * i;
          b.dots[i].classList.toggle('is-active', active);
          if (i < n - 1) done += clamp((p - (LINE0 + STEP * i)) / LINE_LEN);
        }
        if (b.bar) {
          if (b.axis === 'x') {
            b.bar.style.width = (done / (n - 1) * 76.4) + '%'; // Abstand erster bis letzter Punkt: 11,5 % bis 87,9 %
          } else {
            var first = b.dots[0].getBoundingClientRect(), last = b.dots[n - 1].getBoundingClientRect();
            b.bar.style.setProperty('--tl-progress', Math.round((last.top - first.top) * done / (n - 1)) + 'px');
          }
        }
      });
    }
    var ticking = false;
    function onScroll() { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(render); } }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
    window.addEventListener('load', render);
    render();

    // Original-Animation der Hauptseite (Lottie, scrollgebunden wie Elementors "bind to scroll").
    // Player kommt aus der Elementor-Pro-Bibliothek der eigenen Website; ohne Player bleibt die CSS-Rückfallebene.
    function startLottie() {
      var holder = desk.querySelector('.timeline__lottie');
      if (!holder || !window.lottie) return;
      anim = window.lottie.loadAnimation({
        container: holder, renderer: 'svg', loop: false, autoplay: false,
        path: desk.getAttribute('data-lottie'),
        rendererSettings: { preserveAspectRatio: 'xMidYMid meet', progressiveLoad: true }
      });
      anim.addEventListener('DOMLoaded', function () {
        totalFrames = anim.totalFrames;
        desk.classList.add('has-lottie');
        render();
      });
      anim.addEventListener('data_failed', function () { anim = null; });
    }
    if (desk && desk.getAttribute('data-lottie') && !prefersReduced) {
      if (window.lottie) { startLottie(); }
      else {
        var s = document.createElement('script');
        s.src = 'https://provision-infra.de/wp-content/plugins/elementor-pro/assets/lib/lottie/lottie.min.js?ver=5.6.6';
        s.async = true;
        s.onload = startLottie;
        document.head.appendChild(s);
      }
    }
  }

  /* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
  function initFaq() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq__item').forEach(function (item) {
      var btn = item.querySelector('.faq__header');
      if (!btn) return;
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var open = item.classList.contains('is-open');
        // Nur ein Element gleichzeitig offen (wie EAEL Accordion)
        item.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.faq__item.is-open').forEach(function (o) {
          o.classList.remove('is-open');
          o.querySelector('.faq__header').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
        if (!open) { item.classList.add('is-open'); btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true'); }
      });
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Stellen: Filter + Akkordeon ---------- */
  function initJobs() {
    var jobs = document.querySelectorAll('.job');
    function setJob(job, open) {
      job.classList.toggle('is-open', open);
      var btn = job.querySelector('.job__btn');
      if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    jobs.forEach(function (job) {
      var head = job.querySelector('.job__head');
      if (!head) return;
      head.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (e.target.closest('a')) return;
        setJob(job, !job.classList.contains('is-open'));
      });
    });
    var filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter [data-filter]');
    filterBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        filterBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle('is-active', b === btn); });
        var f = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
        jobs.forEach(function (job) {
          var show = f === 'all' || job.getAttribute('data-category') === f;
          job.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !show);
          if (show && !job.classList.contains('animated')) job.classList.add('animated', 'fadeInUp');
        });
      });
    });
    // Deep-Link: /karriere/#job-… öffnet die Stelle direkt (auch bei Hash-Wechsel)
    function openFromHash() {
      if (!location.hash || location.hash.indexOf('#job-') !== 0) return;
      var target = document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));
      if (target && target.classList.contains('job')) {
        target.classList.add('animated', 'fadeInUp');
        setJob(target, true);
      }
    }
    openFromHash();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', openFromHash);
  }

  /* ---------- Init ---------- */
  function init() {
    var y = document.getElementById('year');
    if (y) y.textContent = String(new Date().getFullYear());
    initMenu();
    initSmoothScroll();
    initActiveNav();
    initAnimations();
    initCounters();
    document.querySelectorAll('.carousel').forEach(initCarousel);
    initTimeline();
    initFaq();
    initJobs();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); else init();
})();

</script>
